detectAlienAbductions.name: Alien Abduction Detection
detectAlienAbductions.description: Allows detection of alien abductions in surveyed regions.

detectAlienHumanContacts.name: Alien Contact & Enthrall Detection
detectAlienHumanContacts.description: Allows detection of alien contact and enthrall activities with human factions.

detectAlienOperations.name: Alien Operations Detection
detectAlienOperations.description: Allows tracking of broader alien operational activities across the globe.

estimateAlienThreat.name: Alien Threat Assessment Meter
estimateAlienThreat.description: Estimates alien hostility and hate levels toward human factions.

detectAlienCouncilors.name: Direct Alien Operative Detection
detectAlienCouncilors.description: Directly detects and tracks individual alien operatives (Hydras) operating on Earth.

trackInnerSpaceAssets.name: Inner System Space Surveillance
trackInnerSpaceAssets.description: Skywatch reveals alien vessels and structures inside Saturn's orbit.

trackSolarSystemSpaceAssets.name: Deep Solar System Surveillance
trackSolarSystemSpaceAssets.description: Deep System Skywatch reveals alien vessels and habitats throughout the Solar System within detection range.

detectAlienFacilities.name: Alien Facility Discovery
detectAlienFacilities.description: Alien facilities are visible only after regional discovery, such as Surveil Location or shared intelligence.

detectXenoforming.name: Xenoforming Discovery
detectXenoforming.description: Xenoforming requires the Detect Xenoforming milestone and regional discovery, unless the automatic growth threshold is reached.

abductions.name: Alien Signatures
abductions.description: Detects alien abductions in surveyed regions.

contacts.name: Alien Methods
contacts.description: Detects alien contacts and enthrall activities with human factions.

operations.name: Alien Operations
operations.description: Detects worldwide alien operations and updates the threat meter.

operatives.name: Alien Movements
operatives.description: Directly detects and tracks individual alien operatives (Hydras).
